name: Web
author: Erin Carter
description: An irregular cobweb: silk threads stretched between scattered anchor points into a polygonal mesh of cells with no single hub. The threads waver and sag in the night air, dew beads sit in the cells and glint awake in a slow travelling chase, and each cell carries its own colour from the palette, the whole mesh filling the frame as a real web does.

params.label: Mesh density
params.effect: How many silk cells span the frame; low is a few big sweeping openings, high a fine dense net crowded with dew.

params.label: Irregularity
params.effect: Anchor scatter: 0 is a perfectly regular woven net, toward 1 the anchors wander into a real tangled cobweb of uneven cells.

params.label: Silk waver
params.effect: How much the threads bow and curve organically; 0 holds them dead straight, high makes the silk wander like slack thread.

params.label: Gravity sag
params.effect: Downward droop of the whole mesh, growing toward the bottom; 0 hangs it flat, high pulls the lower web into heavy sagging strands.

params.label: Silk glow
params.effect: Brightness of the thread mesh relative to the dew; low leaves a faint web of bright beads, high lights up every strand.

params.label: Silk weight
params.effect: Thickness of the silk strands, from a fine hairline to heavy roping.

params.label: Dew size
params.effect: Size of the dew beads caught in the cells, from tiny pinpoints to fat droplets.

params.label: Glint speed
params.effect: Rate at which the dew beads light up in a travelling chase across the mesh, from a slow drift to a lively sparkle.

params.label: Colour spread
params.effect: Cell-to-cell colour variety; 0 tints the whole web one hue, 1 scatters the full palette rainbow across the cells.
